profile.source_warning: AEM10-220X page3 pullup prose swaps pins1/3 relative to page4 table. Use physical markings and exact sensor drawing before wiring; do not infer a universal GM harness pinout.

parts.note: Sensor current, derating, hold/trip and supply9..18V at sensor remain acceptance holds; existing VIN_PROT is not an18V regulator.
VH3 keyed internal connector. Deliberately not XH3 sensor5V. Housing/crimp/gland and sensor-side mapping unqualified.
Anode supply, cathode bias. Blocks positive signal fault from directly feeding sensor rail; not a general power-sequence guarantee.
Filter is upstream of hysteresis summing node. Comparator input parasitic capacitance still requires stability review.
Low-leakage clamp upstream of final divider resistor. Conditional cold Vf and hot leakage bounds must be checked; no full-temperature physical rating inferred.
TI classic non-B PDIP8 direct solder, no socket. Common-mode and timing must use classic limits. Unused half has IN+ GND, IN- reference and OUT NC. B-version model cannot qualify this device.
Third series pullup resistor shares conditional sustained negative-fault dissipation; total2250R. Actual temperature/rating/assembly remains unqualified.
